description: This file provides SSR-safe accessors for browser global objects such as window, document, localStorage, confirm, and setTimeout, ensuring compatibility with server-side rendering environments.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object if available, or undefined otherwise.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the document object if available, or undefined otherwise.

methods.name: getLocalStorage
methods.description: Returns the localStorage object if accessible, handling potential errors and SSR context.

methods.name: getConfirm
methods.description: Returns the confirm dialog function bound to the window if available, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: getSetTimeout
methods.description: Returns the setTimeout function bound to the window if available, otherwise undefined.

ctags.name: getSetTimeout
ctags.pattern: /^export const getSetTimeout = (): ((handler: any, timeout?: number) => number) | undefined => {$/
